causal_question: Does an observable spot-perpetual relative-value gap converge after the lagging market starts responding, without forecasting the direction of the whole BTC market?

causality.all adaptive thresholds: rolling completed-minute history shifted by one minute
causality.entry: after the completed confirmation minute only
causality.fair_value_target: confirmation spot close multiplied by exp(pre-event observed basis)

first_week.selection_method: deterministic shuffle of unrevealed Monday weeks after 2023-01-01, excluding every prior candidate-02 week

mutually_exclusive_states.cause: spot carries significant aligned flow and price discovery while the perpetual underreacts and basis moves away from its pre-event level
mutually_exclusive_states.confirmation: next completed minute retains the spot impulse, moves the perpetual in the spot direction and begins closing the lagging basis gap
mutually_exclusive_states.invalidation: event-plus-confirmation extreme beyond a 0.10 ATR buffer
mutually_exclusive_states.target: spot-implied perpetual fair value at the pre-event basis

mutually_exclusive_states.cause: perpetual carries significant aligned flow while spot under-participates and basis widens away from its pre-event level
mutually_exclusive_states.confirmation: next completed minute begins closing basis and perpetual aggressive flow no longer supports the overshoot
mutually_exclusive_states.invalidation: overshoot extreme beyond a 0.10 ATR buffer
mutually_exclusive_states.target: spot-implied perpetual fair value at the pre-event basis

promotion_rule: The central two-minute state portfolio and at least one adjacent one- or three-minute portfolio must pass every gate; each active component with at least two trades must be nonnegative after cost. Only then may the unchanged central rule be locked before a new second BTC week is selected and collected.
